title: (Senior) IT Security Consultant – Vulnerability Management & Container Security (m/w/d)
description: Du möchtest Sicherheitslücken nicht nur identifizieren, sondern deren Analyse, Bewertung und Behebung durch intelligente Prozesse und Automatisierung nachhaltig verbessern? Du arbeitest gerne hands-on mit Security-Tools, APIs und Container-Technologien und möchtest auch KI gezielt für effizientere Security-Prozesse einsetzen? Bei carmasec unterstützt du Unternehmen dabei, ihre digitalen Infrastrukturen sicherer zu machen. Unser Team aus Security-Expert:innen arbeitet mit viel technischer Freiheit, kollegialer Unterstützung und minimaler Reisetätigkeit in anspruchsvollen Projekten. Mit langjähriger Beratungserfahrung, agilen Arbeitsweisen und kontinuierlicher Weiterentwicklung unterstützen wir unsere Kunden branchenneutral und herstellerunabhängig . Wir legen großen Wert auf kollegiale Zusammenarbeit, Wissensaustausch und eine offene Feedbackkultur . Bei komplexen Aufgaben findest du immer Unterstützung im Team. Aufgaben Du analysierst, bewertest und priorisierst Sicherheitslücken anhand von CVE, CVSS, Exploitability und dem jeweiligen Risikokontext und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab. Du implementierst, konfigurierst und entwickelst Vulnerability-Management-Plattformen wie DefectDojo weiter , um Schwachstellen zentral zu erfassen, zu bewerten und nachzuverfolgen. Du integrierst unterschiedliche Security-Scanner und optimierst die Konsolidierung, Normalisierung und Deduplizierung von Security Findings. Du entwickelst und automatisierst Security-Workflows für die Bewertung, Zuordnung und Nachverfolgung von Schwachstellen und setzt dafür APIs, Skripte und geeignete Schnittstellen ein. Du entwickelst KI-gestützte Ansätze zur Analyse, Klassifizierung und Priorisierung von Security Findings und integrierst diese in bestehende Security-Prozesse. Du analysierst und sicherst Kubernetes- und OpenShift-Umgebungen ab , identifizierst Schwachstellen in Container-Infrastrukturen und setzt Maßnahmen für Container Hardening und sichere Konfigurationen um. Du berätst unsere Kunden bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung technischer Sicherheitsmaßnahmen und unterstützt sie dabei, ihr Vulnerability Management nachhaltig zu verbessern. Gemeinsam suchen wir nach Projekten, die zu deinen Interessen und Stärken passen. Qualifikation Deine Fähigkeiten (wichtig für uns) Für uns ist es wichtig, dass Du Spaß daran hast, Neues zu lernen und Dein Wissen weiterzugeben. Das wünschen wir uns von Dir: Du verfügst über mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung im Vulnerability Management und in der operativen IT Security und bist mit der technischen Analyse, Bewertung und Bearbeitung von Sicherheitslücken vertraut. Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse in DefectDojo oder vergleichbaren Vulnerability-Management-Lösungen und Erfahrung mit der Integration von Security-Scannern sowie der Verarbeitung und Nachverfolgung von Findings. Du bist sicher im Umgang mit CVE, CVSS und risikobasierter Schwachstellenbewertung und kannst technische Risiken unter Berücksichtigung von Exploitability und Sicherheitskontext fundiert priorisieren. Du bringst gute Kenntnisse in Kubernetes, OpenShift und Container Security mit und hast Erfahrung in der Analyse und Absicherung containerbasierter Umgebungen. Du hast Erfahrung mit API-Integrationen, Skripting und der Automatisierung von Security-Prozessen . Dabei arbeitest du strukturiert, lösungsorientiert und hands-on und setzt technische Lösungen eigenständig um. Deine Fähigkeiten (nice to have) Über folgenden Fähigkeiten von Dir freuen wir uns, ansonsten erlernst Du die Aspekte im Rahmen der Einarbeitung: Du verfügst über praktische Erfahrung mit KI- und LLM-Technologien und hast diese bereits zur Security-Analyse, Klassifizierung von Findings oder Automatisierung von Workflows eingesetzt. Du besitzt gute Python-Kenntnisse und hast Erfahrung mit Security-Tools wie Trivy, Grype, OWASP Dependency-Track oder vergleichbaren Lösungen. Du kennst dich mit Software Bill of Materials (SBOM), Software Supply Chain Security und Open Source Vulnerability Management aus. Du hast Erfahrung mit Kubernetes-Sicherheitskonzepten wie RBAC, Network Policies, Pod Security Standards oder CIS Benchmarks. Du bringst Kenntnisse in DevSecOps und CI/CD-Security mit und hast idealerweise bereits Security-Scans in automatisierte Build- und Deployment-Pipelines integriert. Falls du nicht alle Punkte erfüllst, freuen wir uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. Benefits Selbstverwirklichung: Freiraum zum Ausprobieren, eine offene Fehlerkultur und die Mitgestaltung von Strukturen im Unternehmen sind bei uns selbstverständlich. Dein Weg zur Expertin/zum Experten: Unsere erfahrenen Mitarbeitenden begleiten Dich bei Deiner persönlichen und fachlichen Entwicklung. Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Arbeite in Deiner produktiven Zeit und plane private Verpflichtungen flexibel ein. Mehrarbeit wird ausgeglichen. Zusatzleistungen: Du hast die Wahl zwischen verschiedenen Angeboten wie Deutschland-Jobticket, Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft, Kitaplatzes Förderung oder Job Rad. Weiterbildungen: Wir investieren in Deine Entwicklung durch regelmäßige Weiterbildungen und renommierte Zertifizierungen. Individuelle Hardware-Auswahl: Du entscheidest, welche Hardware Du nutzen möchtest. Geringe Reisetätigkeit: Wir arbeiten remote oder in unseren Büros in Köln oder Essen. Besprechungen vor-Ort beim Kunden sind bei uns die Ausnahme. Teambuilding: Unser monatlicher Open Space dient der kreativen Arbeit an aktuellen Themen. Regelmäßige Events (z.B. gemeinsame Workation, Sommerfest oder Weihnachtsfeier) werden vom Team selbst geplant und umgesetzt. Workation: Kombiniere Arbeit und Reisen oder nimm Dir eine längere Auszeit im Rahmen eines Sabbaticals. Urlaub: 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr und Sonderurlaub für besondere Anlässe. Du brennst für Cyber Security und bist begeistert, Teil eines starken und diversen Teams zu sein, in dem auch der Spaß nicht zu kurz kommt. Wenn Du unser Unternehmen langfristig mitgestalten möchtest, bist Du bei uns genau richtig! Unser Bewerbungsprozess ist schlank und unkompliziert. Es erwarten Dich keine endlosen Fragerunden oder Assessment Center. Im Interview geht es uns vor allem um den lockeren Austausch und das gegenseitige Kennenlernen. Schick uns lediglich einen kurzen Lebenslauf mit den wichtigsten Stationen, die für die Stellenausschreibung relevant sind. description: Über uns NemoVote ist ein Startup, das Organisationen sichere, geheime und DSGVO-konforme Online-Wahlen und Live-Abstimmungen ermöglicht. Dabei vertrauen uns bereits über 1.000 Kunden. Deine Arbeit hat direkte Wirkung: Was du heute umsetzt, sehen unsere Kund:innen oft schon morgen. In den Semesterferien kannst du auf Wunsch auf bis zu 40 Stunden aufstocken. Oder Praktikant:in Hybrides Arbeiten: Freitag ist unser fester Office-Tag, an dem das ganze Team zusammenkommt. Deine Aufgaben Software Development: Du passt Anwendungen wie unsere Next.js-Website an, entwickelst sie weiter und hältst sie aktuell. Dazu gehören auch SEO, Tracking und unsere Google-Ads-Kampagnen. Technischer Support: Du kümmerst dich um technische Probleme und Fragen unserer Kund:innen und findest Lösungen. Sales-Support: Du unterstützt unseren Vertrieb bei technischen Fragen und Anforderungen von Interessent:innen und hilfst, unseren Vertriebsprozess in HubSpot weiterzuentwickeln und zu automatisieren. Startup-Alltag: Du übernimmst eigene Projekte und bringst deine Ideen ein, wo du Verbesserungspotenzial siehst. Das bringst du mit Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in in einem informatiknahen Studiengang wie Informatik, Medieninformatik oder Wirtschaftsinformatik und schon fortgeschritten im Studium. Idealerweise hast du bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen sammeln können. Webtechnologien: HTML, CSS und TypeScript/JavaScript sind dir vertraut. Idealerweise hast du schon mit einem Framework wie Angular, React oder Next.js gearbeitet. AI im Blut: Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit AI-Coding-Tools wie Claude Code oder willst genau das richtig lernen. Dabei verstehst du den generierten Code gut genug, um ihn zu prüfen und dafür geradezustehen. Du kannst technische Zusammenhänge verständlich erklären, auch Menschen ohne IT-Hintergrund. Du arbeitest selbstständig, packst gerne an und hast Lust auf Abwechslung statt Routine. Du sprichst sehr gut Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse . Das bieten wir dir Enge Zusammenarbeit mit CEO, CTO und COO: Du lernst direkt vom Führungsteam und bekommst Einblick in alle Bereiche, von der Technik über die Prozesse bis zur Unternehmensstrategie. Echte Verantwortung von Anfang an, keine Kaffee-Aufgaben. Moderner Tech-Stack: Durchgängig TypeScript, im Backend auf Node.js. Unsere Abstimmungsplattform läuft auf Angular und NestJS mit GraphQL und WebSockets, die Website auf Next.js, React und Tailwind. Dazu MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis und Keycloak. Deployed wird mit Docker und GitLab CI auf unsere eigene Infrastruktur mit Coolify. Dein Setup, deine Wahl: Ob Mac, Windows oder Linux, du entscheidest, mit welchem Betriebssystem du arbeitest. AI-first Engineering: Bei uns entsteht Software konsequent mit AI. Mit Claude Code arbeitest du agentisch und extrem effizient, von der Planung über die Umsetzung bis zu den Tests. Jede Änderung geht trotzdem durch ein manuelles Code-Review im Team. So lernst du, schnell zu liefern, ohne bei der Qualität Abstriche zu machen. Startup-Atmosphäre: kleines Team, kurze Entscheidungswege, Raum für eigene Ideen. Startup-Netzwerk im AI xpress: Du arbeitest Tür an Tür mit anderen Startups, tauschst dich aus und knüpfst Kontakte in der Gründerszene. Flexibles, hybrides Arbeiten: Freitags ist Office-Tag. EGYM Wellpass: Du trainierst in tausenden Fitnessstudios, Schwimmbädern und Sportkursen in ganz Deutschland. Mitarbeiterangebote: Du bekommst Rabatte bei vielen bekannten Marken und Anbietern, etwa für Technik, Mode oder Reisen. Klingt nach dir? title: AI Researcher - Pre-training (f/m/d)
description: Our Mission Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model . Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg. We are hiring an AI Researcher (f/m/d) to join our Pre-training team and help advance the architecture and training of our next generation of foundation models. If you are excited about how large models learn, want to run experiments that feed directly into production training runs, and want hands-on time on large-scale clusters (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs), we would love to hear from you. Team Culture We foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We collaborate closely on complex technical problems, working in pairs or using mob programming to resolve challenging issues. New team members learn through real work: from your first weeks you will pair with experienced researchers on live problems, and take on more ownership as you grow into it. About the Role As an AI Researcher in Pre-training (f/m/d) , you will work on the technical levers that determine the success of our next-generation models: architecture, optimization, stability, and scaling. Working at the intersection of research and engineering, you will learn to translate mathematical reasoning and empirical observations into principled training decisions, from small-scale proxy experiments to multi-thousand-GPU runs. You will start with well-scoped problems alongside senior researchers and progressively take ownership of larger parts of the training recipe. We are looking for someone with strong fundamentals, sharp experimental instincts, exceptional skills, and the drive to go deep fast. You learn as much from a failed run as from a paper, you write code others can build on, and you want to become an expert in large-scale pre-training. Your Responsibilities Recipe & Architecture Experiments: Design and run ablations on core elements of the training recipe (optimizers, schedules, initialization), and implement PyTorch-based architectural changes. Evaluate their effect on convergence, stability, and training efficiency. Scaling Experiments: Run and analyze small-scale proxy experiments, and contribute to the hyperparameter scaling laws and scale-up methods we use to predict behavior at multi-thousand-GPU scale. Run Monitoring & Debugging: Help monitor large-scale training runs and investigate convergence issues such as loss spikes and divergence. Work with the team to track down distributed training failures. Research to Practice: Follow the literature, reproduce promising results at small scale, and bring ideas worth testing to the team. Cross-Team Collaboration: Work with the Compute Performance, Data, Evaluation, and Post-Training teams to understand how hardware constraints and the rest of the model lifecycle shape pre-training decisions. Core Qualifications You are proficient in Python and have hands-on experience with PyTorch. You have a strong foundation in machine learning, shown through research (e.g., a PhD, a strong MS'c thesis, or publications), open-source contributions, or substantial professional or substantial personal projects. You have a solid mathematical background (linear algebra, probability, optimization) and enjoy reasoning formally about why models train the way they do. You understand how transformers work and have pre-trained LLMs from scratch yourself, even at small scale. You design experiments carefully, report noisy and negative results honestly, and can explain clearly what your evidence does and does not show. You have a track record of picking up unfamiliar technical areas quickly and going deep, for example by reimplementing papers, ramping up on a large new codebase, or debugging a problem well outside your comfort zone. You write clean, maintainable code and care about reproducible experiments. You communicate clearly, raise problems early, and actively seek out and act on feedback. Preferred Qualifications Distributed Training: Experience training models on multi-GPU or multi-node setups, or familiarity with distributed frameworks (e.g., Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, torchtitan) and parallelism strategies (data, tensor, pipeline, expert). Training Dynamics: Familiarity with scaling laws, hyperparameter transfer (e.g., µP), or recent work on optimizers and training stability. Efficient Architectures: Exposure to Mixture-of-Experts, efficient attention variants, or other inference-efficient designs. Research Output: Publications at top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) or contributions to open-source ML training libraries. Systems Curiosity: Low-level kernel optimization is not required, but we highly value a strong curiosity about the hardware and systems constraints that shape scale. raw.description:
monday.com is the AI work platform powering the most ambitious teams. 250,000+ customers across departments use us to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organizations work and outpace their competition.

About The Role

As a Customer Success Manager, you are responsible for the business objectives your customers set to achieve through their AI transformation journey.

This is not the SAAS CSM role we know. Rather than driving adoption and holding the relationship, you reverse-engineer the use cases a customer already runs on the platform and agentify them: you take an existing business process and drive it into the AI era, placing the right AI capabilities in the right places so humans and applied AI work together. You build beside the customer’s own team until the workflow runs. It requires a can-do mindset, strong business acumen backed by technical fluency.

Please note that this is a hybrid position with three days/week in our Munich office.

What You’ll Do

  • Translate use cases: Inventory the use cases an account already runs and agentify them, placing the right AI capabilities in the right places so humans and agents work together.

  • Diagnose workflows: Map where decisions get made and work moves forward, and turn it into a sequenced transformation plan with the customer’s executives and process owners.

  • Build beside the customer: Run working sessions where the customer’s own team builds the workflow, and stay in the room until it runs.

  • Route by account maturity: Use the account maturity audit and Path A readiness to decide what gets built beside the customer and what becomes a scoped engagement.

  • Partner on services: Source engagements for Deployment Strategy with the business context established, and stay connected through delivery so every build lands back into the account plan.

  • Forecast outcomes: Forecast credit burn against entitlement at business-unit level, and diagnose any shortfall: an unbuilt workflow, an unadopted one, or a process that never changed.

  • Advise on governance: Own the permissioning, data boundaries, agent oversight, and approvals that move agents from pilot to production.

  • Lead change with sponsors: Hold the relationships with the sponsors who drive change, tie every workflow to the outcome they need to show, and lead the operating-model shift that makes it stick.

  • Prepare renewals: Evidence delivered outcomes on the T-120/90/60/30 cadence, and surface risk and expansion signals to the Account Owner early enough to act.

The core success component is our ability to drive business outcomes for our customers through the different monday.com layers of operations.

But when breaking it down to the actual day2day we can find :

* Retention of all paid components: seats, AI credits, and services.
* AI consumption growth: adoption of AI capabilities into new and existing use cases, measured as credit burn against entitlement across the account.
*Growth in new AI capabilities usage that drives commercial growth.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of professional experience

  • Experience in customer success, consulting, solutions, or a similar customer-facing role in SaaS, ideally with enterprise accounts.

  • Ability to diagnose how a business process really runs and redesign it with AI and humans working together.

  • Hands-on experience building workflows, automations, or AI agents, and comfort building alongside customers rather than only advising.

  • Credibility with multiple business owners and executives, not only IT or platform owners.

  • Strong commercial and analytical skills: tying usage to business outcomes, forecasting consumption against entitlement, and making a renewal case with evidence.

  • Working knowledge of applied AI governance topics such as permissioning, data boundaries, platform automation, LLMs and agent oversight.

  • Clear communication and the ability to lead change with sponsors across a customer organisation.

  • Experience with high-paced operations and large enterprise customers is an advantage.

description: About us We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies. Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, we fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability. We are well-capitalized and now assembling our team. Our Locations: Vesoma has two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure. Your mission The role As an AI Engineer for Large-Scale Pre-Training, you enter as a key member of the early AI team. You will work directly with our AI leadership and researchers to define the infrastructure we use to train large-scale robot foundation models on petabyte-scale datasets across our GPU fleet. This infrastructure is a critical part of our research and development cycle: it must strike the right balance between stability and velocity, enabling fast research iterations based on reliable results. This is a full-time, permanent position. Your profile Key responsibilities Scalable Training Infrastructure: Develop software infrastructure to train multi-billion-parameter robot foundation models efficiently on large video datasets across multi-node GPU clusters. Data Pipelines: Build high-throughput, reliable data pipelines that stream, decode and preprocess petabyte-scale video datasets, keeping our GPUs fully utilized and supporting deterministic, resumable training. Experiment Management: Build the tools to organize, monitor and optimize large training workloads and model sweeps. Remove bottlenecks in our training pipelines and make sure all our runs maintain the highest possible goodput. Who we are looking for We seek people who embrace the empirical nature of AI research and want to accelerate our research velocity with best-in-class tools - so that we can all make breakthroughs faster, together. Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience training multi-billion-parameter models on multi-node GPU clusters, including supervising long-running experiments, in-flight debugging and optimizing goodput and MFU. Core Skills: Deep expertise in distributed training and training efficiency at scale. In detail: Distributed Training: Data parallelism and sharding (DDP, FSDP/FSDP2, ZeRO), tensor, pipeline and sequence parallelism, and frameworks such as Megatron-Core, DeepSpeed, TorchTitan or JAX/GSPMD. Training Efficiency: BF16/FP8 mixed precision, activation checkpointing, FlashAttention, and profiling with PyTorch Profiler or Nsight Systems. Fault Tolerance: Distributed and asynchronous checkpointing, automatic recovery, and diagnosing NCCL and hardware failures. Core Stack: Python, PyTorch and/or JAX, CUDA, NCCL, and cluster orchestration with Slurm or Kubernetes. A plus: High-throughput data pipelines for large video datasets (WebDataset, Mosaic Streaming, Ray Data, DALI/NVDEC); custom kernels in Triton or CUDA; familiarity with multimodal or robot foundation models (VLAs, video transformers, diffusion/flow-matching policies); experiment tracking and sweep infrastructure (Weights & Biases, MLflow, Hydra). Mindset: You balance the agility of a startup with the professional rigor required for a global industrial player. You are a curious builder who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced research environment, and an engineer with a research mindset who understands the workflows of cutting-edge AI research and supports them with rigorous software engineering.   • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Staff Cloud Architect
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.</span></p></div><p>Are you interested in pioneering and breaking new ground in large-scale financial data processing? Then this role might be for you. Join the Ripple Treasury Reconciliation team where you’ll be solving complex problems and having fun while passionately discussing (and arguing) with your team members!</p> <h1>About the Reconciliation team</h1> <p>Ripple Treasury Reconciliation platform sits at the heart of how the world's largest financial institutions and enterprises close their books and bring more control to their financial processes. Our vision is to create a completely new user experience with financial tools that have no equals on the market. With users first in mind and driven by technology.</p> <p>As part of Ripple, we're backed by the scale and ambition of a company reshaping global finance, giving our team the resources to modernize the mission-critical product while still moving with the speed and ownership of a smaller engineering group. If you want your code to directly touch how billions of transactions get reconciled every day, this is that kind of role.&nbsp;</p> <h1>What we are looking for</h1> <p>We are looking for a Staff Infrastructure Architect to own the infrastructure of our growing Reconciliation platform.<strong> </strong>You'll set the direction, architecture and design for our platform, focusing on performance, stability, security and how to integrate newer technologies. You will also be setting the technical direction and standards for our team while working alongside senior infrastructure engineers who own day-to-day execution and operational work.</p> <p>This is a hands-on architecture role, not a pure strategy or management position. You'll write core foundational code and build reference implementations, but the bulk of routine implementation work belongs to the team. Your value is in judgment: knowing where to invest based on business direction, designing for scalability and lower long-term maintenance burden, and raising the technical ceiling of the team.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Set and own infrastructure architecture direction. </strong>Drive architecture, scalability, and performance decisions across the platform.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Provide technical leadership and mentorship</strong> to senior infrastructure engineers by reviewing designs, unblocking hard problems, and playing a key role in deepening the team's expertise.</li> <li><strong>Establish infrastructure standards and patterns</strong> for the team to create a high benchline for quality, performance and maintenance of the system.</li> <li><strong>Stay hands-on</strong>: prototype, build critical-path components, and get into the code where it matters while routine implementation and day-to-day operational work is owned by the senior engineers.</li> <li><strong>Make and be accountable for infrastructure tradeoff decisions</strong> with long-term cost, scalability, or maintainability implications.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li>BS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li>8+ years of hands-on experience designing and owning large-scale distributed infrastructure, including a track record of owning architecture decisions yourself, with 4+ years serving as a technical lead and mentoring engineers.</li> <li>Deep expertise with AWS &amp; Kubernetes. We're not actively recruiting for this role right now, but we regularly hire Enterprise Account Executives across our EMEA markets and want to build a pipeline of great candidates ahead of time. By registering your interest here, you'll be on our radar — and our Talent Acquisition team will reach out directly as soon as a matching vacancy opens in your location.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>About the Role<br><br>The Infrastructure That Turns AI Into Action<br><br><strong>Locations: Remote (EMEA — UK, Germany, France, Italy, The Netherlands, Sweden, Finland, Spain, or UAE)</strong></h2> <p>Are you a driven, results-oriented sales professional who thrives on building new business from the ground up? You'd engage with senior decision-makers, articulate our value proposition, and close high-value deals in a fast-paced, competitive environment.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>These roles are remote and open to candidates based in the UK, Germany, France, Italy, the Netherlands, Sweden, Finland, Spain, or the UAE, with proximity to key customer hubs an advantage for in-person engagement.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>What the Role Typically Involves</h2> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>• Developing and executing a new business sales strategy within an assigned EMEA territory.</p> <p>• Owning and exceeding a quota focused on new customer acquisition.</p> <p>• Identifying, engaging, and converting new enterprise prospects through strategic prospecting, networking, and relationship-building.</p> <p>• Acting as a trusted advisor, deeply understanding potential customers' business challenges and aligning our solutions to their needs.</p> <p>• Leading the full sales cycle from lead generation to contract negotiation and closure.</p> <p>• Partnering with internal teams, including marketing and pre-sales, to drive high-quality pipeline generation.</p> <p>• Developing joint go-to-market strategies with partners to unlock new opportunities.</p> <p>• Representing the company at industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities to expand market reach.</p> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <h2>What We'll Be Looking For</h2> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>• Proven success in enterprise SaaS sales, with a strong focus on new logo acquisition.</p> <p>• Many years of enterprise software field sales experience, ideally in data integration, data management, AI or a related technology domain.</p> <p>• Strong track record of hunting, closing new business, and exceeding quota in enterprise sales.</p> <p>• Fluency in English required; proficiency in a relevant local language (German, French, Italian, Dutch, Swedish, Finnish, Spanish, or Arabic) is a plus depending on territory.</p> <p>• Ability to engage and influence C-level executives and key decision-makers.</p> <p>• Experience with complex, consultative sales cycles and selling technical platform solutions.</p> <p>• Proficiency in Salesforce, Clari, and MEDDPICC methodology.</p> <p>• Passionate about winning new business—a true sales hunter!</p> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <h2>Interested?</h2> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>If this sounds like you, we'd love for you to register your interest today. Joining our talent pipeline means you'll be among the first to know when an Enterprise Account Executive role opens in your region — giving you a head start on the process and a direct line to our Talent Acquisition team when the time is right. Given the volume of interest these postings attract, we're not able to respond to everyone individually, but rest assured your details are kept on file and reviewed as soon as a relevant opportunity arises.</p> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <h2>Empower Your Authentic Self at Boomi</h2> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>At Boomi, we believe in accountability and transparency, and proudly enable innovation. When you work at Boomi, you can be your true, authentic self in our unique, independent culture.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Be Bold. Be You. Be Boomi.</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-RS1</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-weight: 400; color: #072b55;"><strong>Be Bold. Be You. Be Boomi.</strong> We take pride in our culture and core values and are committed to being a place where everyone can be their true, authentic self. Our team members are our most valuable resources, and we look for and encourage diversity in backgrounds, thoughts, life experiences, knowledge, and capabilities.&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400; color: #072b55;"><em>Boomi strives to create an inclusive and accessible environment for candidates and employees. </em>All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications.</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</em></p> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p><strong>The role</strong></p> <p>HEX brings together creative talent, emerging technology and industry-leading partners to turn innovation into scalable solutions for our clients.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Programme Director to lead the end-to-end delivery of a complex, high-profile programme at the intersection of creative production, AI and emerging technology.</p> <p>You will translate strategic objectives into an integrated delivery plan, bring multiple workstreams together and ensure the programme delivers against its commitments. You’ll take ownership of programme governance, dependencies, risks and decisions, providing the clarity and control needed to navigate complexity and maintain momentum.</p> <p>Working across senior leadership, technology partners, clients and multidisciplinary delivery teams, you’ll connect the bigger picture with the detail of execution, ensuring everyone is aligned on what needs to happen, when and why.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p><strong>Lead the programme</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the integrated programme plan, translating objectives into clear workstreams, milestones, deliverables and success measures.</li> <li>Establish effective governance, clear accountability and a consistent approach to programme reporting and decision-making.</li> <li>Maintain oversight of the critical path, dependencies and delivery commitments, ensuring activity across workstreams comes together to achieve the overall programme objectives.</li> <li>Provide a clear view of programme health, progress and emerging issues, giving leadership the information needed to make timely, informed decisions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Drive delivery</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead delivery across multiple workstreams, aligning teams on priorities, milestones and interdependencies.</li> <li>Anticipate risks, resolve blockers and drive action on issues before they impact delivery.</li> <li>Manage changes to scope, timelines and deliverables, assessing their implications and ensuring trade-offs are agreed and understood.</li> <li>Challenge assumptions, address competing priorities and keep teams focused on the outcomes that matter most.</li> <li>Hold workstream leads accountable for commitments, following through on actions and intervening where delivery is at risk.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Align clients and stakeholders</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across WPP, technology partners and client organisations.</li> <li>Create alignment across teams with different priorities, ensuring clear ownership, timely decisions and a shared understanding of programme objectives.</li> <li>Lead programme reviews and executive reporting, communicating progress, risks, decisions and required actions with clarity.</li> <li>Act as the central point of coordination for programme delivery, connecting stakeholders and ensuring commitments translate into action.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Deliver measurable outcomes</strong></p> <ul> <li>Maintain oversight of performance against programme objectives, milestones, budgets and agreed commercial commitments, working with the relevant commercial and finance leads.</li> <li>Define and track success measures that demonstrate client adoption, business impact and value delivered.</li> <li>Identify emerging delivery or commercial risks, making their implications visible and driving appropriate action.</li> <li>Use performance data and programme insight to inform decisions, address underperformance and improve outcomes throughout the programme lifecycle.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience leading complex programmes involving multiple workstreams, interdependent deliverables and senior stakeholders.</li> <li>A proven track record of translating strategic objectives into executable plans and delivering against challenging commitments.</li> <li>Strong programme management expertise across integrated planning, governance, critical path management, risk, dependencies and change control.</li> <li>The judgement to anticipate problems, navigate ambiguity and make effective decisions when priorities or delivery conditions change.</li> <li>The confidence to challenge constructively, influence senior stakeholders and hold teams accountable across matrixed organisations.</li> <li>Strong commercial awareness, including an understanding of budgets, forecasts and performance against agreed commitments.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear decisions, recommendations and executive-level reporting.</li> <li>A proactive, collaborative approach, combining attention to detail with a clear focus on overall programme objectives.</li> </ul> <p>Experience in creative production, digital transformation, AI-enabled programmes or technology partnerships would be advantageous.</p> <p><strong>What success looks like</strong></p> <ul> <li>A clear, integrated programme plan that connects workstreams, milestones, dependencies and outcomes.</li> <li>Predictable, well-controlled delivery, with risks anticipated, blockers resolved and commitments actively managed.</li> <li>Clear accountability across workstreams and strong alignment between clients, partners and delivery teams.</li> <li>Timely, informed decision-making supported by transparent reporting and a reliable view of programme performance.</li> <li>Measurable client outcomes, with clear evidence of adoption, business impact and value delivered.</li> <li>A programme that meets its objectives while adapting effectively as priorities and requirements evolve.</li> </ul> <p><strong>#LI-HYBRID</strong></p> <p><strong>#LI-RH1</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p style="text-align: left;"><strong>Why work here:&nbsp;<br></strong><span data-teams="true">At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment. </span></p> <p style="text-align: left;"><strong>Inclusion and Impact&nbsp;</strong><br>WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics.   • Migrate many of the company's systems to Cloudflare. This is your first big task.

  • Take a direction from the team and own it, without close supervision.

  • Explain your approach back to the team and talk it through. Disagreement is welcome.

Experience

  • You have 4+ years of experience, including years building and running back-end systems in production. You know how they were deployed and operated.

  • You are hands-on as an engineer in the AI-native era, and you keep reviewing how you work. You follow the latest stacks, models and practices.

  • You have owned something real before. Ownership and leadership are visible in your CV and your projects.

  • You take initiative and work independently. The culture here is high agency: it is often easier to ask for forgiveness than permission.

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Compliance Director and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT.

  • Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions.

  • Experience with clients across several EEA countries.

  • CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business.

  • People who say no without offering a compliant way forward.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

title: Animateur réseaux magasins (H/F)
description: Le Groupe Cybertek est un acteur majeur dans le secteur de la vente de matériel informatique et High-Tech en France. Créé en 1996, son siège social et ses plateformes logistiques se trouvent à Bordeaux. Cybertek possède 28 magasins sous les enseignes Cybertek et Grosbill, ainsi que cinq sites de commerce en ligne. Employant 250 personnes, Cybertek a réussi à atteindre un chiffre d'affaires annuel de plus de 100 millions d'euros en s’appuyant sur des équipes dynamiques et soudées. Le Groupe Cybertek affirme son engagement en faveur de l’égalité professionnelle entre les femmes et les hommes et veille à promouvoir un environnement de travail inclusif, notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap. Vos missions Au cœur de nos magasins répartis sur toute la France lors de vos déplacements quotidiens, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans leur bon fonctionnement, l’accompagnement des équipes et le développement du chiffre d’affaires. Réaliser le suivi des magasins définis : Vérifier et contribuer à la mise en place d’une organisation permettant d’assurer le bon fonctionnement du point de vente (application et respect des procédures internes) ; Veiller et participer à l’amélioration de l’image de marque du point de vente (présentation, ponctualité, propreté, accueil des clients, accueil téléphonique, rappel des clients, relationnel, etc.) ; Contrôler les points de vente (stocks, activités réalisées au sein du point de vente, horaires d’ouverture) ; Contrôler et analyser l’activité commerciale du magasin (devis, commandes, factures, chiffre d’affaires, résultats, objectifs) ; Motiver, accompagner et soutenir les équipes ainsi que le Responsable dans le développement du chiffre d’affaires du point de vente ; Assurer un soutien des équipes par une présence régulière dans chaque point de vente ; Assurer les remplacements en magasin si nécessaires ; Réaliser un entretien mensuel avec chaque Responsable afin d’évaluer l’avancement des objectifs, d’identifier les éventuelles difficultés et de prendre les décisions nécessaires en conséquence ; Suivi des interventions et coordination avec la Direction : Réaliser un rapport sur chaque passage et contrôle d’un point de vente Analyser les données ; Assurer un point régulier avec la Direction au cours d’entretiens ponctuels, par téléphone plusieurs fois par semaine ; Organiser une réunion tous les quinze jours afin de réaliser un point détaillé sur chaque point de vente et de définir les futures interventions ; Réaliser une réunion mensuelle avec la Direction afin de produire un bilan du mois écoulé et de définir les objectifs du mois suivant ; Animer une réunion mensuelle avec les différents services du siège social du Groupe Cybertek en lien avec les magasins, afin d’identifier les difficultés rencontrées et d’améliorer la communication et la coordination entre les différents services (SAV, Technique, Stock, Administratif, etc.) ; L’animation commerciale : Animer les magasins et organiser les journées portes ouvertes (salons, partenariats, etc.) ; Assurer le facing des magasins et veiller à la bonne présentation de l’offre produit et des produits en démonstration ;Assurer le suivi et le reporting des incentives et des différentes opérations commerciales. Vos compétences Vous justifiez d’une expérience dans le suivi et le contrôle de points de vente, idéalement dans le secteur de l’informatique ou de l’high-tech. Rigoureux(se), organisé(e) et doté(e) d’un bon relationnel, vous êtes à l’aise avec l’analyse des performances commerciales, le suivi des stocks et le contrôle du respect des procédures. Vous savez accompagner et soutenir les équipes et les Responsables de magasin dans l’atteinte de leurs objectifs, tout en identifiant les éventuels axes d’amélioration. Autonome, réactif(ve) et force de proposition, vous appréciez le travail de terrain, les déplacements et les échanges avec les différents services. Vous souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et contribuer activement à la performance et au bon fonctionnement de nos points de vente ? Employant 250 personnes, Cybertek a réussi à atteindre un chiffre d'affaires annuel de plus de 100 millions d'euros en s’appuyant sur des équipes dynamiques et soudées. Le Groupe Cybertek affirme son engagement en faveur de l’égalité professionnelle entre les femmes et les hommes et veille à promouvoir un environnement de travail inclusif, notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap.

title: Stage Assistant - Analyste éthique et positionnement (H/F/X) - Paris
description: Nous recherchons un.e stagiaire Assistant.e – Analyste éthique et positionnement (financements institutionnels et partenariats avec le secteur privé) / basé.e à Paris. Le stage se déroulera au sein de l'Institut Humanitaire de Handicap International, dans une équipe de 3 personnes : -        Une directrice de l’Institut -        Deux analystes éthiques et positionnement, chacun.e référent.e, respectivement, pour : Les partenariats opérationnels Les financements institutionnels les partenariats avec le secteur privé L’Institut a pour rôle de : Fournir en interne des éléments d’analyse, de conseil et d’accompagnement concernant les enjeux éthiques et de positionnement d’HI ; Contribuer au rayonnement et à l’influence d’HI pour les enjeux de solidarité internationale. La mission principale du stage est de venir en appui à l’équipe de l’Institut sur ses projets de recherche et d’analyse sur des sujets liés à l’actualité géopolitique, ainsi qu’à l’éthique des financements institutionnels et des partenariats avec le secteur privé. Le stage vise à développer une capacité d’analyse critique et de raisonnement éthique appliqué : comprendre les tensions entre principes et réalités opérationnelles, identifier les risques et les dilemmes et contribuer à l’élaboration de recommandations utiles à la décision. Dans ce cadre, les missions qui vous seront confiées sont les suivantes: Activité 1 – Analyser les enjeux éthiques des partenariats avec le secteur privé -        Réaliser des recherches approfondies sur les activités, les pratiques, les engagements et les controverses associés aux entités concernées. -        Identifier et analyser les arguments en faveur ou en défaveur d’un partenariat en fonction de sa compatibilité avec les valeurs, principes humanitaires et engagements de HI. -        Effectuer un suivi de l’évolution du droit de la Responsabilité Sociétale des Entreprises (RSE) et des pratiques des entités du secteur privé opérant dans des secteurs à risque. Activité 2 – Analyser les enjeux éthiques des financements institutionnels -        Réalise des recherches documentaires et des analyses sur les stratégies, priorités et mécanismes de financement des bailleurs institutionnels. -        Identifier les dilemmes et risques éthiques susceptibles de découler de l’acceptation d’un financement, notamment au regard des principes humanitaires. -        Participer à la formulation d’avis argumentés et de points de vigilance permettant d’éclairer les décisions de l’organisation. Activité 3 – Contribuer à la formation interne et aux relations externes de l’Institut -        Participer à la préparation et à l’animation de séquences de formation et à la présentation de travaux de l’Institut auprès des équipes internes. Contribuer au développement des échanges avec des acteurs externes. Requirements Profil recherché: Vous êtes issu d'une formation Master en en Action Humanitaire/Développement, Relations Internationales ou Droit International, ou toute autre formation permettant de mobiliser des connaissances en géopolitique et en droit international, avec un intérêt particulier pour les enjeux humanitaires, les enjeux opérationnels en zone d'urgence et l’éthique. Vous êtes familier avec le milieu de la solidarité internationale (ONGI, UN, association nationale/locale…); Une expérience préalable à l’étranger et l’engagement dans le milieu associatif sont valorisés Analyse, recherche et rédaction -        Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles en français et en anglais. -        Capacité à conduire une recherche documentaire approfondie, à croiser des sources de nature différente, à en apprécier la fiabilité. -        Capacité à construire une argumentation rigoureuse et à formuler des analyses et recommandations. Connaissances géopolitiques et juridiques -        Bonne connaissance des dynamiques géopolitiques contemporaines des transformations du système international. -        Connaissance des principaux cadres du droit international, en particulier du droit international humanitaire. -        Compréhension des principes humanitaires et des enjeux liés à leur application opérationnelle. Éthique appliquée et positionnement organisationnel -        Intérêt pour l’analyse des dilemmes éthiques rencontrés par les organisations humanitaires. -        Capacité à examiner différentes options et à expliciter les arguments en présence. Benefits Durée: 6 mois Date de démarrage : à partir du 04/01/2027 Type de contrat: Stage Salaire: - Gratification mensuelle de 693€ - Tickets restaurant d’une valeur faciale de 8,96 euros (60 % à la charge de l’employeur, 40% à votre charge) - Participation de 50% à votre abonnement au titre des transports Vous devez disposer d’une convention de stage obligatoire délivrée par un établissement d’enseignement ou de formation français. Les stages proposés chez HI donnent l’occasion aux étudiants d’évoluer dans une organisation internationale et de prendre part à l’action d’Humanité & Inclusion. raw.title: Customer Care Specialist
raw.description:
Making preventive health the default for every human in Europe

 

The mission

At Lucis, we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the OS for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives. You can read more about who we are and how we work here.

 

The role

Health is complex, personal, and deeply important to our members. As the voice of Lucis clients, you support them throughout their health journey and own member happiness end to end.

With rapid member growth, we are hiring our first dedicated Customer Care Team Specialist. You will own the member experience end-to-end, stabilize our operational metrics, and build and manage a world-class support team.

What you will own

  • Member support: Resolve member and lab partner inquiries via chat, email and phone, with warmth, precision and a sense of urgency.

  • Phone-first when it matters: Pick up the phone whenever a situation calls for a human voice: a delayed result, a stressful moment, a confused member.

  • Know your boundaries: Work hand in hand with our medical team and know exactly when to escalate a health question rather than answer it yourself.

  • Voice of the member: Spot recurring issues and turn them into clear, structured feedback for the product and ops teams.

  • Contribute to projects: Take part in initiatives that improve the member experience, like rebuilding our Help Center, designing proactive care for lab delays, or automating repetitive workflows with AI.

 

About you

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You use AI the way others use a calculator: naturally, to go faster and think bigger.

 

You’ll fit in well if

  • Experience: 1+ years in B2C customer care, support, hospitality, or any role where you dealt directly with customers. Strong recent graduates with relevant experience are welcome too.

  • Bilingual: Fluent in both English and French, written and spoken.

  • People-first energy: You bring genuine warmth and empathy to every interaction, and you turn routine support into memorable experiences.

  • Rigorous precision: Exceptional attention to detail, with zero tolerance for misquotes, wrong information or operational errors. In health, accuracy is care.

  • Builder mindset: When something breaks twice, your instinct is to fix the root cause, not just the ticket.

Nice to have

  • Support tooling: You've used Intercom or similar support tools.

  • AI automation: You've already used AI tools to automate part of your work.

  • Startup mindset: You thrive in early-stage environments with high autonomy, rapid execution and clear communication.

 

The process

  • Intro call, culture & role fit (20 min)

  • Case study interview (30-60 min)

  • Deep dive and team chat, on-site (2 hours)

  • Reference calls

How we work

We work together from our Paris hub. We’re passionate about what we’re building and believe the fastest way to create something exceptional is side by side. We’re open to relocation support for the right individuals, and we welcome missionaries who travel to work with us in Paris on a regular basis.

  • Rigor without ego: Audits, science, and code all deserve the same high bar.

  • Radical ownership: Feedback loops are short; everyone contributes to building the best version of Lucis.

  • Velocity over perfection: We ship daily and prefer a good decision today over a perfect one next week.

title: Applied AI Engineer, CyberSecurity, Defense
description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. Role Summary We are seeking an Applied AI, Forward Deployed Engineer to build customer use cases on top of the Mistral stack for our defense, government and critical-infrastructure customers. You will turn "we have agents" into "we shipped something a client uses." This role is about composing cybersecurity-related agentic workflows focused on cyberdefense, configuring harnesses for real-world scenarios, and delivering value directly to clients — often in sovereign, on-premises or classified environments. You will work with some of the most security-sensitive organizations in the world: government agencies, sovereign institutions and operators of critical infrastructure. They need AI that is powerful, controllable and deployable on their terms. Why this role: you will build some of the first AI-for-cyberdefense systems deployed in real government and defense environments, on frontier models you can influence. You will work in a tight-knit team alongside elite experts in DFIR and cyberdefense — people who are passionate about their craft — and the patterns you implement at customer sites feed directly back into Mistral's internal use cases and products. Few roles put this much frontier technology this close to missions that matter. What You Will Do Client-Facing Agentic Solutions You'll individually help deploy into production use cases with considerable business impact, with defense and government cybersecurity assignments as a priority You'll work on state-of-the-art GenAI applications, driving a crucial technological transformation together with our customers Tackle iconic customer use cases that no existing solution on the market can address — from custom configuration of cybersecurity harnesses for cloud defense, to agentic alert triage and investigation, incident response automation, detection engineering, threat intelligence analysis, and security log analysis at scale You'll be involved in pre-sales calls to understand potential customers' needs, challenges, and aspirations, providing technical guidance on our products and explaining Mistral technologies to various stakeholders You'll collaborate with our product and science teams to continuously improve our product and model capabilities based on customer feedback Ship secure by design. Apply least-privilege access, secrets management, authN/authZ best practices, audit logging, human-in-the-loop approval for high-impact actions, and defenses against prompt injection and data exfiltration in agentic systems Design and run evaluations that measure technical correctness, operational value and safety, so customers can trust what is being deployed Own deployment end to end — observability, reliability, cost and latency tuning — including on-premises and air-gapped setups where customers require them Our Principles We care about people and outputs What matters is what you ship, not the time you spend on it Bureaucracy is where urgency goes to vanish. You talk to whoever you need to talk to. The best idea wins, whether it comes from a principal engineer or someone in their first week We say what we mean. Feedback is direct, timely, and given because we care Always ask why. The best solutions come from deep understanding, not from copying what worked before No politics. Low ego, high standards We embrace an unstructured environment and find joy in it Security & Compliance criteria Eligibility: must hold citizenship in the target territory (France for now). Clearable: must meet all local requirements for high-level security clearance About You You are fluent in French, with strong English — this customer set works in French You have 5+ years building systems in a cybersecurity context — SOC automation, DFIR automation, detection engineering, security tooling, or similar — with a record of operating what you ship in production On top of that, you have 1+ year of hands-on experience building agentic or LLM-based systems, ideally in production — with a deep understanding of the concepts: prompting and context engineering, RAG, tool use, agentic orchestration, evaluations, guardrails, and knowing when to use each. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role Summary

We are seeking an Applied AI, Forward Deployed Engineer to build customer use cases on top of the Mistral stack for our defense, government and critical-infrastructure customers. You will turn "we have agents" into "we shipped something a client uses." This role is about composing cybersecurity-related agentic workflows focused on cyberdefense, configuring harnesses for real-world scenarios, and delivering value directly to clients — often in sovereign, on-premises or classified environments.

You will work with some of the most security-sensitive organizations in the world: government agencies, sovereign institutions and operators of critical infrastructure. They need AI that is powerful, controllable and deployable on their terms.

Why this role:

you will build some of the first AI-for-cyberdefense systems deployed in real government and defense environments, on frontier models you can influence. You will work in a tight-knit team alongside elite experts in DFIR and cyberdefense — people who are passionate about their craft — and the patterns you implement at customer sites feed directly back into Mistral's internal use cases and products. Few roles put this much frontier technology this close to missions that matter.

What You Will Do

Client-Facing Agentic Solutions

  • You'll individually help deploy into production use cases with considerable business impact, with defense and government cybersecurity assignments as a priority

  • You'll work on state-of-the-art GenAI applications, driving a crucial technological transformation together with our customers

  • Tackle iconic customer use cases that no existing solution on the market can address — from custom configuration of cybersecurity harnesses for cloud defense, to agentic alert triage and investigation, incident response automation, detection engineering, threat intelligence analysis, and security log analysis at scale

  • You'll collaborate with our product and science teams to continuously improve our product and model capabilities based on customer feedback

  • Ship secure by design. Apply least-privilege access, secrets management, authN/authZ best practices, audit logging, human-in-the-loop approval for high-impact actions, and defenses against prompt injection and data exfiltration in agentic systems

  • Design and run evaluations that measure technical correctness, operational value and safety, so customers can trust what is being deployed

  • We care about people and outputs

  • What matters is what you ship, not the time you spend on it

  • We say what we mean. Feedback is direct, timely, and given because we care

  • Always ask why. The best solutions come from deep understanding, not from copying what worked before

  • No politics. Low ego, high standards

  • We embrace an unstructured environment and find joy in it

Security & Compliance criteria

  • Eligibility: must hold citizenship in the target territory (France for now).

  • Clearable: must meet all local requirements for high-level security clearance

About You

  • You are fluent in French, with strong English — this customer set works in French

  • You have 5+ years building systems in a cybersecurity context — SOC automation, DFIR automation, detection engineering, security tooling, or similar — with a record of operating what you ship in production

  • On top of that, you have 1+ year of hands-on experience building agentic or LLM-based systems, ideally in production — with a deep understanding of the concepts: prompting and context engineering, RAG, tool use, agentic orchestration, evaluations, guardrails, and knowing when to use each. raw.description:
Protect what matters. 

Primion Technology is a global solution provider and market leader in Converged Security Solutions and Workforce Management. For more than 30 years, we have supported around 5,000 satisfied customers worldwide who rely on our certified solutions every day. From consulting and planning to development, installation, maintenance, and support, a team of over 470 dedicated experts works passionately to meet the highest standards. 

PRIMION France is a key growth market within PRIMION's European expansion strategy, focusing on delivering enterprise-grade, software-centric solutions to mid-size and large organizations across French territory.

As an Account Executive (m/f/d), you will acquire new customers and expand PRIMION's presence across enterprise and mid-market organizations. Positioning our integrated software solutions as strategic business enablers, you will guide prospects through the full sales cycle, from lead qualification and solution discovery to contract negotiation and close.

If you enjoy building relationships, uncovering opportunities, and turning them into sustainable business growth, then this role could be the perfect fit for you.

Ready to make an impact? Join us in France within a remote first working approach and play a key role in accelerating PRIMION's growth across one of our most important European markets.

Your Responsibilities

  • New Business Development

    • Identify, target, and develop new enterprise and mid-market accounts across France, with a focus on PRIMION's key verticals (Critical Infrastructure, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Logistics, Public Sector, Financial Services).

    • Build and maintain a healthy, qualified pipeline to consistently achieve and exceed annual revenue targets.

    • Execute structured prospecting activities including outbound outreach, event networking, partner co-selling, and inbound lead follow-up.

  • Solution Selling & Consultative Engagement

    • Conduct detailed discovery conversations to uncover customer pain points around security compliance (NIS2/KRITIS), workforce efficiency, operational risk, and digital transformation.

    • Position PRIMION's integrated software portfolio as a strategic solution rather than a point product, articulating total cost of ownership and business value.

    • Collaborate with Pre-Sales Engineers to design tailored solution architectures and compelling proposals.

  • Sales Cycle Management

    • Own the full end-to-end sales cycle from first contact to signed contract.

    • Manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals involving IT, Security, Operations, Compliance, HR, and C-level decision-makers.

    • Lead commercial negotiations and work with management to structure commercially sound agreements.

    • Maintain accurate CRM hygiene and provide reliable pipeline forecasting.

  • Market & Account Intelligence

    • Develop deep knowledge of the French market landscape, competitive dynamics, and regulatory environment (NIS2, KRITIS, DORA, and relevant French legislation).

    • Identify whitespace opportunities within existing accounts and coordinate with Customer Success for expansion.

    • Represent PRIMION at French industry events, trade fairs, and sector-specific forums.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration

    • Work closely with Pre-Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Marketing teams to ensure seamless customer experiences and aligned go-to-market execution.

    • Provide market feedback to help shape product roadmap priorities and localization requirements for the French market.

    • Demonstrated success in closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals with 6-figure+ contract values.

    • Experience selling to enterprise accounts in at least one of PRIMION's target verticals (Critical Infrastructure, Healthcare, Logistics, Manufacturing, Public Sector, or Financial Services).

    • Comfortable navigating complex organizational structures and building relationships at C-level, VP, and Director level.

raw.description:
Why This Role Exists

At Pennylane, our website plays a pivotal role in acquiring and converting customers, transforming traffic from paid acquisition, SEO, partnerships, and other channels into sign-ups, demo bookings, and product adoption.

 

As we accelerate our Financial Services offering, including pro account, and the monetization of our existing customer base, we are seeking a CRO Manager to own conversion across these strategic areas.

 

You will lead the production and optimization of website pages and paid landing pages, from identifying friction to measuring business impact.

 

You will join the Website team within Growth and collaborate closely with Growth Engineers and Data in a multidisciplinary squad.

 

🌍 About Pennylane

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

 

Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising their clients.

 

Key Figures and Ambition

  • 💻 Over 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane

  • 🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Over 1,100 Pennylaners from more than 25 nationalities

  • 💰 More than €400 million raised since launch

  • 🌍 Remote-friendly, international culture expanding across Europe

 

What You’ll Do

You will own conversion across the Financial Services and Monetization scope, working across website pages, paid landing pages, product journeys, experimentation, and measurement.

 

Own CRO and Experimentation

  • Define and execute the conversion strategy for key journeys, including pro account landing pages, pricing and product pages, demo-booking journeys, self-sign-up, and upsell flows

  • Build and run a continuous A/B testing program, from ideation and scoping to sizing, analysis, and ship-or-kill decisions

  • Identify conversion friction and opportunities through analytics and behavioral insights

  • Develop clear hypotheses based on user behavior, business priorities, and funnel performance

  • Ensure experiments are measured against meaningful business outcomes

 

Manage the Website Conversion Roadmap

  • Own and prioritize the conversion roadmap for your scope based on expected impact and feasibility

  • Turn opportunities into actionable briefs, specifications, and delivery plans

  • Work closely with Growth Engineers, Data, Design, and other stakeholders to ship improvements

  • Coordinate QA, launch, and post-launch analysis

  • Own key Financial Services journeys, including pro account activation and the accountant portal

  • Contribute to monetization journeys such as upsell and self-sign-up

 

Build and Optimize Paid Landing Pages

  • Produce and optimize landing pages for Financial Services and Monetization campaigns

  • Help increase the speed and volume of landing-page delivery, removing the current bottleneck

  • Partner with Demand Generation and Paid/SEA teams to translate campaign objectives into high-performing pages

  • Develop a strong understanding of target audiences, market context, and local messaging

  • Use these insights to improve both paid landing pages and the wider website experience

 

Own Measurement and Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Define instrumentation and tracking plans with Data

  • Build and maintain dashboards to monitor conversion performance

  • Report on results, learnings, and next steps to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Work closely with Demand Gen, Product, Sales and Customer Success Operations, Brand, Design, and Engineering

  • Create alignment across teams and move projects forward without relying on formal authority

 

What You Bring

  • 3–5 years of experience in CRO, Conversion, Website Product Management, Growth, or a related field

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, digital products, or another data-driven environment

  • A track record of shipping initiatives end-to-end and demonstrating their impact on business metrics

  • Strong hands-on experience with analytics and CRO tools, such as Amplitude and Contentsquare

  • Ability to independently analyse data, identify patterns, and formulate relevant hypotheses

  • Solid understanding of A/B testing methodology, including experiment sizing, success metrics, statistical pitfalls, and decision-making

  • Experience managing a roadmap and prioritizing initiatives based on impact and feasibility

  • Strong project management skills, from writing a clear brief to coordinating delivery and measuring results

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to:

    • Write clear briefs for designers and engineers

    • Explain prioritization decisions to stakeholders

    • Present results and recommendations to non-technical audiences

  • Ability to build relationships and secure alignment across multiple teams

  • Fluent French and professional English

 

🛠️ Tools and Environment

You will work with tools and processes dedicated to experimentation, analytics, behavioral analysis, tracking, and landing-page production.

 

Some our Tools Include

  • Amplitude

  • AB Tasty

  • Analytics and reporting dashboards

  • Website content and landing-page production tools

 

You will collaborate closely with Growth Engineers, Data, Demand Generation, Product, Sales and Customer Success Operations, Brand, and Design.

 

What You Can Expect

  • Ownership of conversion across two strategic areas for Pennylane: Financial Services and Monetization

  • Direct and measurable impact on sign-ups, demo bookings, product activation, and upsell performance

  • The opportunity to shape the conversion roadmap across website and paid landing pages

  • A central role in structuring and scaling our experimentation program

  • Close collaboration with Growth Engineering, Data, Product, Demand Gen, Sales, Customer Success Operations, Brand, and Design

  • High level of autonomy and visibility across the organization

  • Challenging and supportive environment focused on ownership, execution, learning, and measurable impact

 

Success in This Role

Your success will be measured by:

 

  • The frequency and quality of experiments launched

  • The speed and volume of website and landing-page delivery

  • Conversion-rate improvement across the Financial Services and Monetization funnels

  • Growth in relevant outcomes, including sign-ups and demo bookings

  • Ability to absorb inbound landing-page demand without creating a delivery bottleneck

  • Quality of tracking, reporting, and learnings shared with stakeholders

 

📍 Location & Working Model

Permanent position based in Paris on a hybrid basis or fully remote anywhere in France.

 

🌈 Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

Pennylane is dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace, providing equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of background, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic.

 

If you’re excited about this role and think you could make an impact, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t meet every requirement.

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

Most LLM roles stop at experimentation.

Here, the models you improve power experiences for 50M+ users.

Most of our traffic runs on self-hosted, fine-tuned open-weight models. On our internal roleplay evals, our smaller fine-tuned models can outperform much larger off-the-shelf models. Your job is to make them better.

You’ll join a small AI team led by Marco, our LLM Tech Lead, working closely with our CTO, Product, Web and DevOps teams. You’ll work across data, post-training, evals, and model behavior, taking ideas from failure analysis to production.

The problems are real: personalization, character consistency, long conversations, better evals, multilingual behavior, and faster training cycles.

If you want to shape model behavior at consumer scale, this is the role.
